description: 429s where the server gave up instead of waiting (llm_rate_limited with outcome daily_limit, max_attempts or budget_exhausted). outcome=retry is a normal wait; fallback_preferred is a deliberate skip to the next provider.
filter:
resource.type="cloud_run_revision"
jsonPayload.event="llm_rate_limited"
NOT jsonPayload.outcome="retry"
NOT jsonPayload.outcome="fallback_preferred"
